%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: false, error: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message: error.description, timestamp: now() }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: false, error: "EMPLOYEE_ERROR", message: error.description, employeeId: vars.originalPayload.employeeId, timestamp: now() }

logger.message: Database error during asset allocation: #[error.description]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: false, error: "DATABASE_ERROR", message: "Asset allocation failed due to database error", timestamp: now() }

db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM employee_sync WHERE employee_id = :empId AND status = 'ACTIVE'

logger.message: Employee details found in local sync table: #[vars.employeeDetails.employee_id] (synced from #[vars.employeeDetails.sync_source])
Employee not found in local sync table, calling employee onboarding API...
Local employee sync table unavailable, calling API directly
Employee details retrieved from API: #[vars.employeeDetails.employee_id]

db:insert.db:sql: MERGE INTO employee_sync (employee_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, department_id, position, hire_date, status, manager_name, sync_source, last_sync_date) VALUES (:empId, :firstName, :lastName, :email, :phone, :deptId, :position, :hireDate, :status, :manager, :syncSource, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ empId: vars.employeeDetails.employee_id, firstName: vars.employeeDetails.first_name, lastName: vars.employeeDetails.last_name, email: vars.employeeDetails.email, phone: vars.employeeDetails.phone, deptId: vars.employeeDetails.department_id, position: vars.employeeDetails.position, hireDate: vars.employeeDetails.hire_date, status: vars.employeeDetails.status default 'ACTIVE', manager: vars.employeeDetails.manager_name default null, syncSource: 'employee-onboarding-api' }]

Employee onboarding API unavailable - creating fallback record
Employee details retrieved directly from API (DB unavailable)

set-variable.value: #[{ employee_id: vars.originalPayload.employeeId, first_name: vars.originalPayload.firstName default 'Unknown', last_name: vars.originalPayload.lastName default 'Employee', email: vars.originalPayload.email default (vars.originalPayload.employeeId ++ '@company.com'), phone: vars.originalPayload.phone default '+1-555-0000', department_id: vars.originalPayload.departmentId default 1, position: vars.originalPayload.position default 'Employee', status: 'PENDING', sync_source: 'fallback-record' }]

logger.message: Created fallback employee record for: #[vars.employeeDetails.employee_id]
Starting asset allocation for employee: #[vars.originalPayload.employeeId]

set-variable.value: #[if (payload is String) upper(payload replace '-' with '_') else upper(payload['type'] replace '-' with '_')]

logger.message: Looking for available asset of type: #[vars.assetType]

db:select.db:sql: SELECT a.*, ac.category_name FROM assets a JOIN asset_categories ac ON a.category_id = ac.id WHERE ac.category_name = :assetType AND a.status = 'AVAILABLE' LIMIT 1

db:update.db:sql: UPDATE assets SET status = 'ALLOCATED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = :assetId

db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO asset_allocations (asset_id, employee_id, allocated_date, status, allocation_reason, approved_by) VALUES (:assetId, :employeeId, CURRENT_DATE, 'ACTIVE', :reason, :approvedBy)

No available assets found for type: #[vars.assetType]
